bibl.title: Slavery and Agency in the Middle Ages.
bibl.seg: Craig Perry, Slavery and Agency in the Middle Ages.
Craig Perry, David Eltis, Stanley L. Engerman & David Richardson, The Cambridge World History of Slavery. Volume 2. AD 500-AD 1420 (Cambridge, 2021) pp. 240-267.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Studies of "enslaved humanity" in medieval Italian and Iberian contexts. - Slavery in the Islamic world: Legal, cultural, and social factors. - Sex, domesticity, and slavery. - Legal pluralism: Enslaved people and owners as legal objects and litigants. - Everyday and extreme forms of resistance. - A guide to further reading.
